title: nephrodium rufescens
intro: Nephrodium rufescens, commonly known as Autumn fern, is a type of fern plant. It is known for its health benefits, which include lowering inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Autumn fern include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Autumn fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
